verdict.rationale: Notte's docs say scripts can be deployed as serverless Functions/API endpoints that you can "invoke and schedule anywhere," and position the platform for deploying production workflows. That is the only scheduling mention, and "schedule anywhere" may mean triggering the endpoints from an external scheduler rather than a native scheduler. Missing for 10: explicit native recurring/cron scheduling documentation, details on recurrence configuration and run history or monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.
